parameters.jsCode: const source=$input.first().json||{};const execution=(source.execution&&typeof source.execution==='object')?source.execution:{};const executionId=String(execution.id||source.executionId||source.execution?.id||'');const workflow=(source.workflow&&typeof source.workflow==='object')?source.workflow:{};const node=(source.node&&typeof source.node==='object')?source.node:{};const errorObject=(source.error&&typeof source.error==='object')?source.error:{};if(!executionId)throw new Error('ERROR_HANDLER_MISSING_EXECUTION_ID');return [{json:{executionId,workflowId:String(workflow.id||source.workflowId||'unknown'),workflowName:String(workflow.name||source.workflowName||'Customer-Safe Incident Update Writer'),failedNode:String(node.name||source.failedNode?.name||source.failedNode||'unknown'),errorMessage:String(errorObject.message||source.message||source.errorMessage||'Unknown workflow failure').slice(0,500),occurredAt:new Date().toISOString()}}];

parameters.jsCode: const response=$input.first().json||{};const status=Number(response.statusCode||response.response?.statusCode||0);const executionId=String($('Sanitize Error Details').first().json.executionId||'');if(!status||status<100||status>599)return [{json:{mappingFound:false,operatorNotice:true,executionId,notice:'Execution mapping lookup returned missing status'}}];if(status===404)return [{json:{mappingFound:false,operatorNotice:true,executionId,notice:'Execution mapping not found'}}];if(status!==200)return [{json:{mappingFound:false,operatorNotice:true,executionId,notice:'Execution mapping lookup failed HTTP '+status}}];const body=response.body||response.data||response.json||response;const mappedExecutionId=String(body.executionId||'');const jobId=String(body.jobId||body.job_id||'').trim();const tenantId=String(body.tenantId||body.tenant_id||'').trim();if(!mappedExecutionId||mappedExecutionId!==executionId||!jobId||!tenantId)return [{json:{mappingFound:false,operatorNotice:true,executionId,notice:'Execution mapping response missing or mismatched execution, job, or tenant'}}];return [{json:{mappingFound:true,operatorNotice:false,executionId,jobId,tenantId}}];

parameters.jsCode: const response=$input.first().json||{};const status=Number(response.statusCode||response.response?.statusCode||0);if(!status||status<100||status>599)throw new Error('ERROR_JOB_UPDATE_MISSING_STATUS');if(status<200||status>=300)throw new Error('ERROR_JOB_UPDATE_FAILED_HTTP_'+status);const body=response.body||response.data||response.json||response;const mapping=$('Verify Error Mapping and Job Update').first().json||{};if(!mapping.mappingFound||!mapping.jobId||!mapping.tenantId)throw new Error('ERROR_JOB_UPDATE_MAPPING_MISSING');if(body.success!==true||String(body.jobId||body.job_id||'')!==String(mapping.jobId)||String(body.tenantId||body.tenant_id||'')!==String(mapping.tenantId)||String(body.status||'')!=='failed')throw new Error('ERROR_JOB_UPDATE_RESPONSE_MISMATCH');return [{json:{jobMarkStatus:'failed',mappingFound:true,executionId:mapping.executionId,jobId:mapping.jobId,tenantId:mapping.tenantId,operatorNotice:false,sharedStateResponse:body}}];
